facts.text: MiddleLayerVariableListBase is the common base of the read-only and writable variable lists
MiddleLayerVariableListRO sets read_only to True and is constructed from a MiddleLayerVariableListROSpec
MiddleLayerVariableListRO.put, set, set_and_wait and change_set_wait_method raise ReadOnlyError
get_all_mlv_count returns the number of all member variables
get_all_mlv_names returns the names of all member variables
get_mlv_names returns a copy of the enabled variable names
get_enabled_mlvs refreshes the enabled status and returns the enabled member variables
get_enabled_status returns a deep copy of the enabled-status list
put_enabled_status requires one status per member, returns when unchanged, and otherwise replaces the status list and reinitializes the enabled members
get reads every enabled member variable and tries to build one quantity array, leaving the list when the dimensions differ
enable_parallel_get and disable_parallel_get set the list flag and propagate it to the member PV objects
The list starts with one True enabled status per member variable
The read-only list spec carries the member variables and a parallel_get_enabled flag
A machine unit conversion is built from the repr_units of the deployment element definition
A PAMILA device spec carries its components and its get and put action specs
The PAMILA machine module requires the PAMILA_FACILITY environment variable at import
The MLVL example loads a machine configuration from examples/demo_generated/<facility>
